title: On the k-abelian complexity of the Cantor sequence
notes: arXiv:1703.04063. The Cantor sequence c=101000101⋯ is the fixed point of 0↦000, 1↦101 starting at 1, equivalently c_{3n}=c_{3n+2}=c_n and c_{3n+1}=0. For every k≥1 the k-abelian complexity of c is 3-regular. Principal base-3 benchmark for the kabelian_complexity gate.
